connectorUiConfig.title: Cisco Duo Authentication
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Cisco Duo connector ingests authentication log data from the Cisco Duo Admin API into Microsoft Sentinel.

Supports HMAC-based API Key authentication (Integration Key and Secret Key).

For more information, visit [Cisco Duo Admin API Docs](https://duo.com/docs/adminapi#overview).

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: All authentication events from the last 24 hours
sampleQueries.query: DuoAuthentication_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | project TimeGenerated, UserName, ApplicationName, Result, Reason, Factor | take 100
DuoAuthentication_CL | where Result in ('denied', 'failure', 'fraud', 'error') | project TimeGenerated, UserName, ApplicationName, Result, Reason, AccessDeviceIp | order by TimeGenerated desc
DuoAuthentication_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize count() by Result | order by count_ desc
DuoAuthentication_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize AuthCount = count() by UserName | order by AuthCount desc | take 20
DuoAuthentication_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where isnotempty(AccessDeviceCountry) | summarize count() by AccessDeviceCountry | order by count_ desc

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Cisco Duo API Key
customs.description: A Cisco Duo Integration Key and Secret Key are required. These are obtained by creating an Admin API application in the Duo Admin Panel. [See documentation](https://duo.com/docs/adminapi#overview).

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Obtain Cisco Duo Admin API credentials
instructionSteps.description:
1. Log in to the [Cisco Duo Admin Panel](https://admin.duosecurity.com).
2. Navigate to **Applications** and click **Protect an Application**.
3. Search for **Admin API** and click **Protect**.
4. Copy the **API Hostname**, **Integration Key**, and **Secret Key**.
5. Ensure the application has **Grant read log** permission enabled.

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Connect Cisco Duo to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Enter your Cisco Duo Admin API credentials below to begin ingesting authentication logs.
